subject: Re: Redwood demo — security questionnaire & scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@zephyrbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zephyrbank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood demo — vendor onboarding steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the invite to run a live demo. Before our InfoSec/procurement team will approve any hands-on session that involves screenshots or any production data, they require two things completed: a signed mutual NDA and a completed vendor security questionnaire. I attached the questionnaire (Zephyr_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) for your security team to fill out.

Our procurement lead is looped here (procurement@zephyrbank.com) and will drive the onboarding cadence once the questionnaire and NDA are in. Realistically, procurement is indicating they won't greenlight the deep-dive demo until those are completed — we can consider a high-level executive overview in the meantime if helpful.

Tentative window for an in-depth demo is the week of Aug 11–15, but nothing is firm until onboarding is complete. Can you share an estimate of how long it typically takes your team to complete the questionnaire and where we should send the NDA for signature?

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Senior Vendor Manager
Zephyr Bank

Attachment: Zephyr_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 file)

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — vendor onboarding steps

Sara — really appreciate the heads-up and the questionnaire.

We can absolutely sign an NDA and complete the questionnaire; I attached our draft NDA to speed things up. A couple notes:
- Our security lead (Rachel) can take point on filling the questionnaire; turnaround is usually 48–72 hours depending on level of detail requested.
- Our SE who would run the deep-dive is travelling the week of Aug 4–8, so full demo availability is limited then.
- If you need an earlier touchpoint, we can do a redacted high-level walkthrough (screenshots only, no access) the week of Aug 4, but I understand InfoSec may prefer waiting until onboarding completes.

Can procurement confirm whether a signed NDA + the questionnaire returned to procurement@zephyrbank.com is enough to unblock scheduling, or if there are additional vendor-check steps? If procurement wants, Vivek (cc'd) from legal can provide the signed mutual NDA directly.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vivek signs the NDA and returns a signed PDF to procurement (within 24 hours).
2) Rachel starts the questionnaire and returns it within 48 hours.
3) We pencil a deep-dive for Aug 14 at 10:00 AM ET as a placeholder and move it earlier if procurement confirms sooner.

Attaching: Draft_Mutual_NDA_Redwood.pdf

—Jordan

Thanks Vivek — receiving a signed NDA is helpful and speeds the vendor intake. Procurement typically has a 3–7 business day review once the questionnaire is returned, depending on backlog.

A couple of clarifications from procurement:
- Please return the completed questionnaire to procurement@zephyrbank.com with the subject line: "Zephyr Vendor Security — Redwood Inference".
- If you can provide redacted screenshots or a short video walkthrough for an exec-level preview, procurement will accept that as an interim touchpoint; however, engineers will not be granted access until onboarding completes.

Given the review window, the earliest realistic deep-dive would be Aug 12–15. If you can fill out the questionnaire today or tomorrow, procurement will try to prioritize it.

I'll hold a placeholder for Aug 14 10:00 AM ET and circle back when procurement confirms.

Regards,
Sara Lin
Senior Vendor Manager
Zephyr Bank
